text:
Anna: Quick mock — adding an 'Invoke preview' step in run history so QA can inspect tool outputs without re-running. Screenshot: https://redwood.in/s/preview-mock Sam: Love this. Where would the preview live? Inline panel under the invocation row, or a modal? Rui: Inline collapsible in the run history row. Keeps context and preserves keyboard flow. Avoid modals for this. Maya: Agree. Also we need to clearly indicate if the tool call was side-effecting vs read-only. QA needs that upfront. Anna: Design idea: small chevron labeled 'Preview' that expands below the invocation. The expanded area shows three tabs: Inputs | Output (structured) | Schema + validation state, and a CTA 'Send to QA'. Sam: Copy nit: 'Send to QA' > 'Handoff to QA' imo. "Send" is lighter. Maya: Accessibility nits: when expanded, focus should move to the close button (so keyboard users don't lose place). Use aria-expanded and an aria-live region for streamed outputs. Rui: Backend: we need to snapshot tool outputs at run-time so the preview is stable even if models or tool responses change later. Snapshot id + persisted JSON. Anna: UX: show structured tree view by default with a small 'View raw' toggle to show the raw code block. Schema validation should show a green check or red badge with a short error count. Nick: Function defs: long param lists are noisy. Collapse to 'n params (show)' with a keyboard-friendly expander. Show default values inline when collapsed as a tooltip. Sam: Action copy discussion: the top-level button currently says `Invoke`. Some designers prefer `Run` for consistency across playground. Engineers like `Invoke tool` because it's explicit. Maya: My take: top-level use `Run` (general), inside a tool card use `Invoke`/`Call` depending on audience. But we should A/B it. Anna: Also propose a compact diff view: when previewing an output after a rerun, show small inline diff (▴▾) with highlighted token changes and a 'View full diff' button. Rui: Accessibility detail: output streaming should update `aria-live="polite"` region, but for large updates mark `aria-atomic="false"` so screen readers don't read entire output repeatedly. Anna: Example snippet for the preview container: ```
...
``` Sam: Keyboard shortcuts? `k` to toggle preview for focused run row. Need to avoid conflicts. Nick: Small perf note — structured tree rendering should virtualize deep nodes. Otherwise huge JSONs will stall the UI. Maya: Contrast: the 'Send to QA' CTA currently uses the low-contrast gray. Need to bump to brand color to meet AA. Anna: I'll update the mock to show inline expand + structured tree + small diff + CTA 'Send to QA'. Sam — can you update copy options? Rui — can you scope the snapshot API? Nick — can you prototype keyboard expander? qa-bot: Created ticket #234: "run-history: preview + QA snapshot" with link https://redwood.in/t/234 and attached mock. Sam: +1. I'll throw up two copy variants for A/B: (A) Run / Call tool (B) Invoke / Run. We'll test with 50 internal users. Rui: I'll add a /snapshots endpoint and a migration to persist outputs for the last 90 days. We'll expose snapshot ids in run history metadata. Anna: Thanks all — feeling good about inline preview approach. I'll push updated Figma and annotate a11y behaviors. :tada: Sam: Nice work — excited to see the prototype. Maya: One more micro-ux: when collapsed, show a 1-line summary: "Output: {status} — 3 keys — schema ok" so QA can triage faster. Anna: Good call. Adding that to the mock. Sam: done :thumbsup:
